title: Signal: Gradle properties point at a cleartext repository
scope: A gradle.properties file that declares a repository URL property that uses cleartext http.
limitations: It matches a repository URL property that uses cleartext http in the parsed gradle.properties; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A gradle.properties that mentions a repository URL property that uses cleartext http in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
